It is important to know which elections you are voting in, and to understand the role of local governance.

Local Government Elections (LGE) shape the communities we live in every day.

📢They decide:
🔹Who represents you in your ward and becomes the voice of your community
🔹Who leads your municipality, including the mayor and council
🔹How public money is spent, and which community priorities come first
🔹How services are delivered, from water and electricity to roads, housing, and waste removal
🔹How accountable local leaders are to the people they serve

Simply put, Local Government Elections determine how your community is run and how your future is shaped. 

When you vote, you’re not just choosing leaders, you’re choosing the kind of community you want to live in.
